title: Все мои старые цвета
originalTitle: Boku no Oldies wa All Color
alt: My All-Day All-Color 僕のオールディーズはオールカラー
description: A minimalist adaptation of Seizou Watase's manga of the same name. It contains 5 stories of slow paced vignettes of romance whose only dialogue lies within the "oldies" being played as background music.

en: Boku no Oldies wa All Color
